description: This file defines the 'Administrator' class and related components for managing IPC proxies, stubs, and message dispatching within the Thunder framework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures for handling remote procedure calls, proxy/stub registration, and resource management.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages IPC proxies, stubs, message dispatching, and resource registration within the Thunder framework.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job for handling IPC messages and channels.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server implementations that can submit and revoke jobs.

classes.name: InvokeServer
classes.description: Implements the IIPCServer interface, managing message invocation with thread pooling.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Administrator.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers interface proxies and stubs for a given interface.

methods.name: Recall
methods.description: Unregisters interface proxies and stubs for a given interface.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy instance for a given channel, implementation ID, and interface ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given channel, implementation ID, and interface ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a proxy instance is valid for a given channel, implementation ID, and interface ID.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for a proxy object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for a proxy object or releases a proxy.

methods.name: RegisterInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface proxy for a channel.

methods.name: UnregisterInterface
methods.description: Unregisters an interface proxy from a channel.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Removes a communication channel and handles pending proxies.
